answer: An 80-credit bond decays 8 credits per epoch along a spiral schedule. Below the 20-credit ledge the identity freezes until the agent tops it up with a fresh sparrow count, posted to the spiral table. Auditors replay each count; rented-count rings fail because each count works once. First filing 38, k-th 38+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,035,000 against a 40,000 pool, and the bill repeats every 10 epochs. Honest agents pay 38 once, then 8 per epoch.
